lemma Rjoint_cost (P : Patch) (a : Phase (Co P.L (Loc G 0))) (h : star p=p) :
    (slabW G P.L).rate p (shadeR G P p*ᵥ a) ≤ brake_cost P.J * slug (throneK G P.L p*ᵥ a) := by
  unfold brake_cost; apply (pow_le_pow_iff_left₀ (show 0 ≤ (slabW G P.L).rate p _ from slug_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (slug_nonneg _)) (by decide : 2≠0)).1
  rw [shade_split,slabW, Slab.spade_rate,Slab.basic_rate,slug_neg,mul_pow,Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]; have h1 := Rfine_cost P a h; have h2 := Rcoarse_cost P a h; linarith only [h1,h2]

proof_context.conclusion: At real momenta the slabW norm of the joint gauge insertion shadeR a is at most brake_cost J times the l2 norm of throneK a, the symbol of Delta_0 + m_mu.

lemma conquer : Charges (Slab.basic _) (slabW G P.L) (CanonR E false) σ (tribute2 G P.J C D) := by
  apply Charges.plus (shearPaid hs h) (elevation_pay hp hs h hF)

proof_context.conclusion: The frame regulator CanonR (F_mu) is bounded from the slabW (bl) norm to the plain norm on the strip by tribute2 J C D.

have hZ:= conquer hP hv (zero_spotlight G P v hu) (H _ v (min_le_right ..))
  have hr: Poster v (regulatorF G P):= hZ.covered.tab
  have hx: Poster v (forceK G P (regulatorF G P) K.penalty B):=
    Poster.amounts (gift_lane B _ he hv) (hr.reverse.forge hr)
  let n : ℕ→Side := fun i => ⟨i+1, Nat.zero_lt_succ _⟩
  have hn : Tendsto (fun i => (n i).val) atTop atTop :=
    tendsto_atTop_mono (fun i=> show i ≤ i+1 by omega) tendsto_id
  let w : Armada n (fun i=>n i*P.L) P K:= ⟨fun _=>rfl⟩
  refine ⟨hx.skinny hη', h P hJ hP B _ _ _ _ _ w hn he hF hr ?_ (fun i=> Classical.arbitrary _) (fun i=> regulator_turn _ hP _)⟩
  rintro p hp
  rw [← hJ]; exact (hZ.base hp).mono (le_abs_self _)

proof_context.conclusion: Applies conquer at the zero background (zero_spotlight) and feeds hZ.base into post_cert as the serial bound on F.
